fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on Florida Power & Light Company electricity rates and alleged monopolistic practices; Miami municipal cost-cutting proposals affecting police and other city employees; and scrutiny of a bus agreement between the City of Miami and the Miami Beach Railway Company. Also covers Dade County road construction questions (including the Key Largo road), prohibition-era enforcement and allegations involving Coast Guard boat 248, and local tourism/entertainment promotions and advertisements in Greater Miami and Miami Beach.
